declarations.obtainedFrom: Written by the engine when the plugin-authoring skill loads (<bundled-skills>/<version>/<hash>/plugin-authoring/types/claude-code.d.ts), and beside a loaded mod as .claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts
declarations.stability: EARLY ACCESS: this surface may change between releases without notice.

evidenceKinds.declared: The signature appears verbatim in the named declarations and the probe compiles against them with tsc (strict).
evidenceKinds.validated: `claude plugin validate` reports the probe's hooks and calls with no refusal.
evidenceKinds.test-kit: `claude plugin test` (the engine's offline kit, claude-code/testing) passes the named probe test.
evidenceKinds.live: Observed in a running host session. None recorded: the user deferred live probes on 2026-11-04.

tests: a mechanical command answers with text and makes no model call
capabilities.notes: Handlers receive raw `args`; the token grammar is Specplane's to implement. The validator classifies a command.run hook as gating: it needs an explicit .catch, because a failing hook is skipped and the chain continues.

tests: registers only names the inventory does not own, and the completion tool
one failed registration does not skip the others
capabilities.notes: Which names 2.1.317 actually owns as built-ins (e.g. /approve) is a live fact and is not recorded.

tests: a command not from a direct user gesture is refused
capabilities.notes: `origin.kind === 'composer'` is engine-stamped (the user's own gesture; an unattested channel arrives unclassified). A plugin's $.command.run cannot supply an origin. Plugins at a higher tier can still skip or change this mod's hooks.

tests: confirmation uses the host dialog; a refusal to ask means unavailable
capabilities.notes: $.ui.ask is raised as a tool.call of AskUserQuestion through every hook but the calling one, so another installed plugin's hook can answer it. Treat its answer as weaker than a composer-origin command; rejects under -p (headless means unavailable).

tests: delegation submits an extension-origin prompt without asUser
capabilities.notes: Test-kit host check: $.prompt.submit from a command.run hook is refused ('it would wait on the turn this hook is holding; submit from a later event (turn.complete)'). Delegation must queue and submit later. Without asUser the origin stays { kind: 'plugin' }. A registered tool is listed as mcp__<plugin>__<name> and served by a tool.call hook. Whether turn.complete fires after an idle-session command is a live fact and is not recorded.
next.signal compiles in a command.run hook; abort behaviour is not exercised offline.

declarations: export type ToolCallInput = ToolCallEnvelope & AgentLoop & ToolRequestMeta;
capabilities.notes: tool.call carries agentId (absent on the main loop) but no model field. A subagent's model comes from agent.spawn's result; the main loop's from $.session.model() at hook time. A model switch on the main loop between calls is therefore attributed by hook-time reads only; this is not yet proven to be action-time.

Route A ($.agent.spawn): cwd, resume { agentId }, maxTurns and a stable agent id are declared. Budget is turns or effort, not money. Do not use isolation: 'worktree' (the spec forbids extra worktrees).

declarations: run: (argv: readonly string[], init?: ProcessRunInit) => Promise<ProcessRunResult>;
capabilities.notes: Route B: $.process.spawn by argv array running `claude -p --session-id|--resume <id> --max-budget-usd <n> --output-format stream-json` (flags present in `claude --help` 2.1.317 and the headless docs). The headless docs call the reported cost figures client-side estimates that can differ from the bill; --bare skips installed plugins unless --plugin-dir is passed. Launch, observe and resume are not executed: live evidence deferred.
